mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, change_kind, method_name, base_path, target_path, base_symbol, target_symbol, base_start_line, base_end_line, target_start_line, target_end_line, base_content, target_content, details FROM semantic_method_change WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY COALESCE(target_path, base_path), COALESCE(target_start_line, base_start_line), change_kind
